verdict.rationale: Locating UI elements is a fair question for a computer-use agent like Simular, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents how Sai locates elements: no mention of an accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, or coordinate grounding. Live viewing of the agent's computers and self-healing replays are adjacent debugging aids, not documentation of the perception method.

support.subject: As a developer, the approach to locating UI elements (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, coordinates) is documented, so misclicks are debuggable
